title: Search pages and capture a thought
description: Find a saved sample page, then use quick capture to keep a short thought at the reader.
steps: Search the Notebook for a checklist.
Open the matching page.
Use the quick-capture shortcut, type sample writing, and save it.

title: Write in today’s page
description: Open the daily page and type a short sample reading log.
steps: Open the Notebook’s daily page.
Type a short reading log.
Leave the writing field and view the saved text.

title: Keep one page at several places
description: Attach a sample page to two passage references and a thread.
steps: Open a sample checklist and choose + Place.
Enter two references, one at a time.
Add the page to an existing thread and inspect its place chips.

title: Pin and nest your pages
description: Pin a checklist, then move it inside another page.
steps: Open a sample checklist.
Choose Pin from the page menu.
Choose Move inside and select its parent page.

title: Follow links and backlinks
description: Follow a link to another sample page and return through its backlink.
steps: Open a checklist containing a page link.
Click the linked page title.
Use Linked from to return to the checklist.

title: Work with a checklist and table
description: Tick a task, add a table row, and save the block.
steps: Open a prepared sample page with a heading, checklist, and table.
Tick a task and open Edit table.
Add a row and save the block.

title: Read a reference-backed passage block
description: Change a passage block’s line layout and Bible version while its text comes from the database.
steps: Open a prepared passage block.
Choose Lines for a verse-per-line display.
Switch to YLT, inspect the result, then return to KJV.

title: Keep source cards in a page
description: Inspect a lexical card and a thread card, then open the thread’s page.
steps: Open a sample page containing a Strong’s entry and thread card.
Inspect the source-backed word entry.
Scroll to the thread card and open its page.

title: Track a question and give it a page
description: Mark a sample question answered, move it to its own page, then reopen it and fold it back.
steps: Open a prepared question block and mark it answered.
Choose Give it its own page at the same place.
Reopen the question, then fold it back into its original page.

title: Browse a live notebook view
description: Open a page with a filtered notebook list and follow one of its results.
steps: Open a prepared notebook dashboard.
Inspect the results filtered to the chapter.
Click a result to open its saved page.

title: Reuse a page as a template
description: Save a checklist as a template, inspect the preview, and make another page from it.
steps: Open the sample checklist’s menu and save it as a template.
Choose Make a page from it and inspect the preview.
Make the new page.

title: Undo a page deletion
description: Delete a disposable sample page and restore it with the visible Undo control.
steps: Open a temporary sample page.
Delete it using its page menu.
Choose Undo and reopen the restored page.

title: Collect word occurrences in a thread
description: Select two occurrence results, name a thread, then open and color its page.
steps: Open Every use from a word card.
Tick two results and add them to a named thread.
Open the thread in the Notebook and choose its color.

title: Browse saved highlights
description: Open the highlight list to inspect two saved sample marks.
steps: Open the Highlights menu.
Choose Your highlights, listed.
Inspect the saved marks and their references.
